life-sciences.shape: a Claude plugin with its own MCP server; read for its knowledge files only
life-sciences.use: The product team's setup notes per module (visits, samples, territories, Admin Console settings and more), troubleshooting guides and per-release module notes. Its validation rules are SOQL checks to verify against the org before trusting them. Where an installed cartridge covers Life Sciences, the contract consults it instead.

net-zero.shape: a Claude plugin with its own MCP server that installs only from source; read for its knowledge files and knowledge skills only
net-zero.use: Net Zero Cloud's setup order, data model and modules (buildings, vehicles, scope 3, waste, water, the Disclosure and Compliance Hub), troubleshooting, and persona journeys for shaping a demo. Its validation rules are hints to verify. Never load its metadata or data files.
org_wide: Net Zero Cloud and carbon accounting settings (Industries Settings)
Disclosure and Compliance Hub package installs

revenue-cloud.shape: a skills library with deployment automation (Release 264); read its domain skills and product docs only
revenue-cloud.use: Revenue Cloud's data model and ERDs, pricing, constraint models, decision tables, expression sets, usage, ramps, renewals, document generation, business APIs, troubleshooting and a demo script. The repo also ships deployment automation (CumulusCI flows, scripts and datasets) that its skills tell agents to run; Scout never runs any of it.
org_wide: activating pricing procedures and expression sets

automotive.shape: a Claude plugin with its own MCP server that installs only from source; read for its knowledge files and knowledge skills only, not its copy of the admin guide
automotive.use: Automotive Cloud's data model clusters, dependency-ordered setup (permission sets and licences first), modules (vehicles and assets, captive finance, warranties and claims, inventory and dealers, scheduler, connected services, rebates, partner visits), data load order, troubleshooting, and persona journeys for shaping a demo. Its validation rules are hints to verify. Read the admin guide in the Salesforce Docs instead of a copy. Never load its metadata or data files.
org_wide: Digital Experiences (enabling Experience Cloud for the org)
Automotive Settings, Vehicle Connected Services Settings and other Automotive Cloud settings pages

manufacturing.shape: a Claude plugin with its own MCP server that installs only from source; read for its Manufacturing Cloud modules and knowledge skills only, not its generic platform notes or its org-comparison, Slack-analysis and entity-check tools
manufacturing.use: Manufacturing Cloud's data model and modules (sales agreements, account manager targets, advanced account forecasting, rebates, partner visits, warranty lifecycle, asset service lifecycle, product portfolio, inventory allocation, count and management, manufacturing programs, analytics), their setup and configuration steps, and implementation checklists for shaping a demo. Never load its metadata, data or config files. Its notes sometimes say an object isn't available "in this org": that was the authors' org, so check the standard capability in yours and in the Docs (for example warranty claims and supplier recovery use the standard Claim and Contract objects) before proposing a substitute.
org_wide: Manufacturing Settings toggles (Sales Agreements, Account Manager Targets, Advanced Account Forecasting, Rebate Management, Partner Visit Management, Warranty Lifecycle Management)
forecast period settings and forecast dimensions
multiple currencies and exchange rates (enabling multi-currency is irreversible)
